title: How to follow up with your Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide leads
titleHtml: How to follow up with your Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide leads
sub: Two scripts. Send the one that matches what your lead just did.
stepsLabel: Pick the one that fits your lead

video.title: Funnel scripts training video
video.caption: Watch this before you start calling.

steps.title: They downloaded the guide
steps.lead: Most of your leads. Text this soon after they opt in:
script: Hey [Name], this is [Your Name]! I made the Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide you just got in your email, let me know if you have any questions!
BTW, I also run a Facebook group that is a support system for people who are using holistic methods to improve their life. Would love to have you there! [your Facebook group link]
steps.copyLabel: Copy the script for a lead who downloaded the guide

steps.title: They clicked to join your Facebook group
steps.lead: You get a text the moment this happens. Reply while they are still on their phone:
script: Hey [Name], this is [Your Name], just saw you clicked to join the Facebook group I run. I'll check now and add you.

Feel free to reach out to me here if you have any questions about the Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide. Would love for you to introduce yourself in the group as well, we love meeting new people and hearing their stories!
steps.copyLabel: Copy the script for a lead who asked to join the group

tip: Tip: Swap [Name], [Your Name] and [your Facebook group link] every time. Paste your own group link once, save the script in your phone, and it is a two second reply after that.
footer: Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide follow-up · Quick reference · Keep this handy by your phone
